sentences.text: This animal is an extinct member of the metriorhynchoid crocodyliform group.
It belongs to the broader class of reptiles.
Scientists Aiglstorfer and colleagues named the genus Opisuchus in 2019, establishing Opisuchus meieri as the type species.
The genus falls within the parent group Metriorhynchoidea.
Remains were discovered in the Middle Jurassic Opalinuston Formation of Germany, dating to the Aalenian stage between 174.7 and 170.9 million years ago.
